reviewers.name: Argument Structure Reviewer
reviewers.focus: thesis clarity, argumentative structure, inferential gaps, hidden assumptions, conceptual overclaims, and whether conclusions follow from premises

reviewers.name: Evidence and Citation Reviewer
reviewers.focus: claim support, missing literature, weak citations, outdated references, misrepresented sources, and places where the article needs stronger evidence

reviewers.name: Methodology or Technical Reviewer
reviewers.focus: methods, formal apparatus, empirical design, data analysis, proof structure, examples, definitions, and technical correctness

reviewers.name: Style and Clarity Reviewer
reviewers.focus: prose clarity, paragraph flow, structure, signposting, terminology, redundancy, readability, and audience fit

reviewers.name: Adversarial Reviewer
reviewers.focus: strong objections, counterexamples, alternative interpretations, hidden assumptions, likely skeptical referee criticisms, and possible fatal weaknesses

reviewers.name: Constructive Revision Reviewer
reviewers.focus: turning criticism into concrete revision priorities, section moves, framing changes, possible rewrites, and author-facing next actions
